title: Five dead, five injured after Amazon cargo plane overshoots Miami runway
subhead: At least five people were killed on Sunday as an Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway, crashed into vehicles and caught fire. In addition to five fatalities, three people were transported to trauma centers 'in critical condition' while two others were treated at a local hospital.

title: 'China will not replace the United States as a global power'

title: Frida Kahlo's paintings, the wealthy collector and her cunning friend spark a fight for Mexico's art
subhead: On September 8, part of the most important collection of modern Mexican art assembled by Jacques and Natasha Gelman will be exhibited in Spain. The future of this priceless collection now lies with the Spanish bank Santander. In Mexico, a collective fears that these paintings, considered national heritage, may never be displayed in their home country again.

title: French left renews push to raise inheritance taxes, from forced philanthropy to wealth transfer cap
subhead: From the CFDT trade union to presidential candidates Raphaël Glucksmann and Marine Tondelier, the idea of increasing inheritance taxes is back on the table. The far-right Rassemblement National opposes it. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is considering another option: compulsory philanthropy for large inheritances.
